code:
all: scheme

scheme: scheme.y scheme.l
	bison -d -o parser.tab.c scheme.y
	flex scheme.l
	gcc parser.tab.c lex.yy.c -o scheme

clean:
	rm -f parser.tab.c parser.tab.h lex.yy.c scheme
description: This Makefile generates and compiles a Scheme parser and lexer.

steps.description: The default target builds scheme from its Bison and Flex source files.
Bison generates parser sources, Flex generates the lexer, and GCC builds the executable.
clean removes the generated files and executable.

title: Build the Scheme example
